nusmp.beastwill.codex.title: Beast Will
nusmp.beastwill.codex.what.title: What a Beast Will is
nusmp.beastwill.codex.what.text: The will of a powerful mana beast, kept in a core. It is not a summon, a pet or a plain transformation: it is the beast's way of being, living in you. You hold at most eight wills but bind one at a time.
nusmp.beastwill.codex.get.title: Getting one
nusmp.beastwill.codex.get.text: Only beasts of rank A or higher can leave a core, and only rarely; a dragon will is rarer still. The core drops from a wild, full grown beast. A beast that a quest or event has marked may also offer its will itself: sneak and use an empty hand on it. Using a core shows what it is and what it asks, and nothing is taken until you agree.
nusmp.beastwill.codex.learn.title: Assimilation and mastery
nusmp.beastwill.codex.learn.text: A new will is weak. Assimilation grows while you hold a form and fastest while you meditate (sneak and stay still). Mastery grows from using the form and its abilities, and from fighting. Both have a daily limit, so grinding does not help. A will that fits your race grows faster.
nusmp.beastwill.codex.forms.title: Two forms
nusmp.beastwill.codex.forms.text: Acquire: modest bonuses and one or two basic abilities, a quiet glow. It opens after a little assimilation. Integrate: stronger bonuses, the signature abilities, a stronger look and a higher drain. It needs almost full assimilation and half mastery. A form ends when you run out of energy, when strain gets too high, or when you end it. Integrate can not run with another transformation.
nusmp.beastwill.codex.strain.title: Strain
nusmp.beastwill.codex.strain.text: Using a form and abilities builds strain, resting and meditating lower it. Strained: a little weaker. Exhausted: weaker, slower. Overload: the form breaks and hurts you, and you are quiet for a while. If you push an ability past the edge the will warns you first; press again and it can reject you for ten minutes and cost you a little assimilation. You never lose the will or anything else.
nusmp.beastwill.codex.keys.title: Keys
nusmp.beastwill.codex.keys.text: %s Acquire form, %s Integrate form (press again to end it), %s first ability, %s second ability, %s switch will (Shift: previous). All of them can be changed in the controls. /beastwill status shows your progress in words.
nusmp.beastwill.codex.wills.title: The four wills
nusmp.beastwill.codex.wills.text: Dragon Will (Aether): perception, resilience, a draconic pulse, and a short, bounded time exclusion that never touches bosses and never stops the world. Shadow Panther Will (Shadow): speed, quiet steps, a veil, a dash and an ambush. Elderwood Guardian Will (Plant): mending, vines that hold and a bark ward. Lion Will (Might): strength, endurance, and the World Howl that pushes foes back.
